transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I’ve been having thoughts that really scared me. I catch myself thinking it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up, and sometimes when I’m driving home I wonder if my family and my students would be better off without me. I don’t want to act on it, but the fact that I’m thinking like that is why I came in.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and feelings?
It’s been going on for about a year and seven months. It started around when I took over the STEM assessment redesign at school, on top of my regular teaching load.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yes. I used to really look forward to things like softball, book club, working in my garden, and helping with robotics club. Lately I either cancel or I still show up, but I’m just… going through the motions. It doesn’t really feel enjoyable anymore.
Have you noticed that you're moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, that you feel restless or can't stay still?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change like that. Maybe I’m a little slower to get going sometimes, but I haven’t had anyone tell me I’m talking slower, and I don’t feel especially restless or like I can’t sit still.
Can you describe how your mood has been lately? Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

I’m not sure how to put it exactly. I do feel pretty low a lot of the time lately, but I haven’t really been tracking whether it’s most of the day or every day. It’s just been more often than not, I guess.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re a failure, or have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yes. I’ve been blaming myself a lot more. Like if a lesson doesn’t go well, or a student seems confused, I take it really personally. I’ll keep thinking about it afterward, like it proves I’m a terrible teacher. And then it kind of spreads into feeling like I’m failing at home too, like I’m letting everyone down as a mother.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or have been consumed by guilt most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I think so. It’s been happening a lot. If a lesson goes badly or a student looks confused, I take it as proof that I’m letting everyone down. I keep replaying it afterward, like I’m a terrible teacher, and then it turns into feeling like I’m failing as a mother too.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?

Yes. I’m definitely slower with things that used to be straightforward. I’ll read the same student answer three or four times and still not know what score to give it. Even simple decisions, like which lab supplies to order, can make me freeze up for an hour.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue most of the time, nearly every day?

Yes. Most days I feel completely drained. By the time I’ve taught my classes and gotten through a department meeting, my body just feels heavy. Even making dinner or answering a few parent emails feels like climbing a hill.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past year and a half? For example, have you been eating significantly more or less, or lost or gained a noticeable amount of weight?

Yes. On school days especially, I’ll often just not eat until late afternoon. Sometimes I forget, sometimes I avoid it because I don’t feel like dealing with it. And over the past year my clothes have gotten noticeably looser, even though I haven’t been trying to lose weight.
Have you ever had a period of time before this current one, lasting at least a couple of weeks, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced other similar symptoms?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had stressful times before where I felt low for a few days, but I can’t clearly remember another stretch like this that lasted weeks.
Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?

I honestly can’t think of a clear time like that before this. I’ve had rough patches or felt down for a few days here and there, but I don’t remember anything lasting more than a couple of weeks the way this has.
Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
I don’t think so. I know I’ve had bad weeks before, like anyone, but I can’t really point to another time where it went on for more than a couple of weeks like this.
Can you think back to any other times in your life, before this current period, when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
No, not that I can remember. I’ve had times where I felt low for a bit, but I can’t think of another period before this where it lasted more than a couple of weeks.
Can you recall if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for more than two weeks in a row?
I really can’t recall a time before this where it was that constant for more than two weeks. I’ve had low days, but nothing that stands out like that.
